items.caption:
Approval gates keep high-impact automations fast and reversible.

1. AI prepares the draft
2. Store the proposed action
3. Ask for approve or reject
4. Execute only after approval

Automate the preparation and keep one tap of human control.

items.takeaway: Automate the preparation and keep one tap of human control.
items.voiceScript: Use A I for speed, not irreversible permission. Let the model prepare a draft, store the proposed action, ask a human to approve or reject, and execute only after approval. This works for emails, payments, deletions, and publishing. You automate almost all the work while keeping one tap of control. Save the pattern. My free n eight n templates are in the bio.
